title: IAM Service responses read by Gateway
description: IAM /auth/* bodies behind the public routes in docs/api/authentication.md. Login and refresh carry refreshToken in the body; Gateway moves it into the HttpOnly cookie and strips it from the public response.

user.description: IAM account identity: id and email (ADR 0003).

sessionResponse.description: POST /auth/login and POST /auth/refresh -> 200 { accessToken, refreshToken, user }
